items.title: AnyMind與Meta公布直播商務合作
items.title_en: AnyMind and Meta partner on live commerce, with a phased Facebook and Instagram rollout
items.summary: AnyMind Group於10月27日宣布與Meta合作，讓品牌透過直播影片廣告連接直播購物；Facebook支援預計由2026年第四季開始，Instagram預計2027年初跟進。
items.summary_en: On October 27, AnyMind Group announced a Meta partnership linking live video ads to livestream commerce. Facebook support is planned from Q4 2026, with Instagram to follow in early 2027.
items.why: 對經營亞太社交電商與跨平台直播的品牌，值得檢視廣告引流、直播互動與成交之間的銜接。
items.why_en: Brands running APAC social commerce can assess the journey from paid discovery to livestream purchases.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
highlights: Facebook預計由2026年第四季開始，Instagram預計2027年初跟進。
AnyMind表示支援真人、AI及混合直播模式，結帳可連接品牌自有渠道、電商平台或商務訊息。
highlights_en: Facebook support is planned from Q4 2026; Instagram is expected in early 2027.
AnyMind describes human, AI and hybrid livestreams, with checkout through owned channels, marketplaces or business messaging.
items.detail:
AnyMind Group於10月27日宣布與Meta合作，讓品牌透過直播影片廣告連接直播購物；Facebook支援預計由2026年第四季開始，Instagram預計2027年初跟進。

對經營亞太社交電商與跨平台直播的品牌，值得檢視廣告引流、直播互動與成交之間的銜接。

Brands running APAC social commerce can assess the journey from paid discovery to livestream purchases.

Confirm eligible markets, accounts, checkout routes and measurement before a limited test.

items.title: Universal Ads新增Campaign Management合作類別，連接既有平台與電視廣告採購
items.title_en: Universal Ads adds Campaign Management partners to connect existing platforms with TV buying
items.summary: Universal Ads於10月27日宣布在Business Partners Program新增Campaign Management類別，讓12家首批合作夥伴把電視廣告採購接入既有媒體管理流程。平台表示支援API及MCP整合。
items.summary_en: On October 27, Universal Ads announced a Campaign Management category in its Business Partners Program, naming 12 initial partners that can bring TV activation into existing media workflows. The platform says it supports API and MCP integrations.
items.why: 對同時管理搜尋、社交及串流電視廣告的團隊，跨渠道規劃和衡量流程值得評估。
items.why_en: Teams planning across search, social and streaming TV can evaluate whether the integrations simplify cross-channel buying and measurement.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
highlights: 公告列出12家首批合作夥伴，包括Kochava、Koddi、Topsort及WorkMagic。
合作平台可接入電視廣告啟動流程；逐平台進度、庫存與地區仍須確認。
highlights_en: The release names 12 launch partners, including Kochava, Koddi, Topsort and WorkMagic.
Partners can embed TV activation; integration status, inventory and geographic access should be confirmed individually.
items.detail:
Universal Ads於10月27日宣布在Business Partners Program新增Campaign Management類別，讓12家首批合作夥伴把電視廣告採購接入既有媒體管理流程。平台表示支援API及MCP整合。

對同時管理搜尋、社交及串流電視廣告的團隊，跨渠道規劃和衡量流程值得評估。

向實際使用的合作平台確認整合進度、庫存覆蓋、地域及歸因方法，再考慮小額測試。

12家是公告中的合作夥伴，不能推定每家均已全面啟用或提供香港庫存。
items.detail_en:
On October 27, Universal Ads announced a Campaign Management category in its Business Partners Program, naming 12 initial partners that can bring TV activation into existing media workflows. The platform says it supports API and MCP integrations.

Teams planning across search, social and streaming TV can evaluate whether the integrations simplify cross-channel buying and measurement.

Confirm partner integration status, inventory, geography and attribution before a limited test.

The 12 are announced partners; full activation by each and Hong Kong inventory access are not established.
items.next_step: 向實際使用的合作平台確認整合進度、庫存覆蓋、地域及歸因方法，再考慮小額測試。
items.next_step_en: Confirm partner integration status, inventory, geography and attribution before a limited test.

items.title: Smartly與Alter Agents公布500名英美行銷人員AI調查，強調人工審批
items.title_en: Smartly and Alter Agents survey 500 marketers on AI and human approval
items.summary: Smartly與Alter Agents於10月27日公布一項涵蓋500名美英行銷從業員的調查，訪問於7月21日至31日進行；77%受訪者表示，當人類保留最終審批權時，對AI廣告感到安心。
items.summary_en: On October 27, Smartly and Alter Agents announced a survey of 500 US and UK marketers, fielded July 21–31. In the sample, 77% said they were comfortable with AI in advertising when humans retain final approval.
items.why: 研究可協助團隊討論AI創意流程中的審批責任與披露政策。
items.why_en: The findings can inform discussion of AI creative approvals and disclosure governance.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
highlights: 樣本包括250名美國及250名英國行銷人員，均有至少五年經驗。
77%受訪者表示，在人類保留最終審批權時，對AI廣告感到安心。
highlights_en: The sample comprises 250 US and 250 UK marketing professionals, each with at least five years of experience.
In this sample, 77% are comfortable with AI advertising when a human has final approval.
items.detail:
Smartly與Alter Agents於10月27日公布一項涵蓋500名美英行銷從業員的調查，訪問於7月21日至31日進行；77%受訪者表示，當人類保留最終審批權時，對AI廣告感到安心。

研究可協助團隊討論AI創意流程中的審批責任與披露政策。

檢視內部AI素材審批、品牌一致性及披露準則。

委託調查只涵蓋具至少五年經驗的美英行銷人員，不能推論香港市場或廣大消費者。
items.detail_en:
On October 27, Smartly and Alter Agents announced a survey of 500 US and UK marketers, fielded July 21–31. In the sample, 77% said they were comfortable with AI in advertising when humans retain final approval.

The findings can inform discussion of AI creative approvals and disclosure governance.

Review internal approval ownership, brand consistency and AI disclosure policies.

The commissioned sample covers experienced US and UK marketers, not Hong Kong marketers or the general consumer population.
items.next_step: 檢視內部AI素材審批、品牌一致性及披露準則。
items.next_step_en: Review internal approval ownership, brand consistency and AI disclosure policies.

items.title: Bluefish推出Paid Media Briefs，連接AI搜尋洞察與付費媒體規劃
items.title_en: Bluefish introduces Paid Media Briefs to connect AI visibility with paid-media planning
items.summary: Bluefish於10月27日宣布Paid Media Briefs已作為Optimization Suite的延伸功能提供，向媒體團隊提出Google及ChatGPT相關的受眾、創意與落地頁建議。
items.summary_en: Bluefish announced on October 27 that Paid Media Briefs is available as an extension of its Optimization Suite, offering targeting, creative and landing-page recommendations for Google and ChatGPT.
items.why: GEO與付費廣告可能逐步形成共同規劃流程，值得留意指標能否互通。
items.why_en: GEO and paid media planning may converge, making metric compatibility worth evaluating.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
highlights: 已公布提供的是媒體規劃建議，不能據此推定可直接自動購買廣告。
公司表示正開發MCP及API整合；額外付費媒體渠道仍屬擴展方向。
highlights_en: The announced offer provides planning recommendations; direct automated ad buying is not established.
The company is developing MCP and API integrations and plans broader paid-media coverage.
items.detail:
Bluefish於10月27日宣布Paid Media Briefs已作為Optimization Suite的延伸功能提供，向媒體團隊提出Google及ChatGPT相關的受眾、創意與落地頁建議。

GEO與付費廣告可能逐步形成共同規劃流程，值得留意指標能否互通。

要求供應商提供支援平台、資料權限及歸因方法清單，再評估試用。

媒體建議屬供應商產品聲明；直接自動投放、獨立量化成效及全面渠道覆蓋均未獲證實。
items.detail_en:
Bluefish announced on October 27 that Paid Media Briefs is available as an extension of its Optimization Suite, offering targeting, creative and landing-page recommendations for Google and ChatGPT.

GEO and paid media planning may converge, making metric compatibility worth evaluating.

Request supported-platform, data-permission and attribution documentation before testing.

Recommendations are vendor-described capabilities; direct automated buying, independently measured results and universal channel coverage are not established.
items.next_step: 要求供應商提供支援平台、資料權限及歸因方法清單，再評估試用。
items.next_step_en: Request supported-platform, data-permission and attribution documentation before testing.

items.title: Brandi AI公布Content Compass 2.0與Brand Voice等GEO內容及分析更新
items.title_en: Brandi AI adds Content Compass 2.0 and Brand Voice to its GEO platform
items.summary: Brandi AI於10月27日宣布Content Compass 2.0、Brand Voice、Collections及分析功能更新，讓行銷與公關團隊根據AI答案中的品牌呈現情況，管理內容優化建議。
items.summary_en: On October 27, Brandi AI announced Content Compass 2.0, Brand Voice, Collections and analytics updates for managing content recommendations informed by how brands appear in AI answers.
items.why: GEO工作可以由單純監測提及，延伸至內容修訂與品牌語氣審批。
items.why_en: GEO workflows may extend from mention monitoring into content revision and brand-voice approvals.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
highlights: Content Compass 2.0及Brand Voice提供內容優化建議，保留團隊的編輯決策。
Optimization Hub與Brand Voice須在使用新Content Editor的客戶工作區啟用；分析與Collections更新逐步推出。
highlights_en: Content Compass 2.0 and Brand Voice provide optimization guidance while teams retain editorial control.
Optimization Hub and Brand Voice require enablement in workspaces using the new Content Editor; analytics and Collections updates are being introduced progressively.
items.detail:
Brandi AI於10月27日宣布Content Compass 2.0、Brand Voice、Collections及分析功能更新，讓行銷與公關團隊根據AI答案中的品牌呈現情況，管理內容優化建議。

GEO工作可以由單純監測提及，延伸至內容修訂與品牌語氣審批。

先檢視品牌語氣規範與內容審批流程，要求產品示範如何追蹤建議及發布後的可見度。

工具提供優化建議，並不代表保證AI引用或營收提升；功能啟用及推出階段須分開確認。
items.detail_en:
On October 27, Brandi AI announced Content Compass 2.0, Brand Voice, Collections and analytics updates for managing content recommendations informed by how brands appear in AI answers.

GEO workflows may extend from mention monitoring into content revision and brand-voice approvals.

Review brand guidelines and editorial sign-off, then request a demonstration of recommendation tracking and post-publication visibility measures.

Optimization advice does not guarantee AI citations or revenue; workspace enablement and staged rollout should be checked separately.
items.next_step: 先檢視品牌語氣規範與內容審批流程，要求產品示範如何追蹤建議及發布後的可見度。
items.next_step_en: Review brand guidelines and editorial sign-off, then request a demonstration of recommendation tracking and post-publication visibility measures.

items.title: Meta美國政治及社會議題廣告限制期於10月27日開始
items.title_en: Meta starts its US political and social-issue ad restriction period
items.summary: Meta於10月27日更新官方選舉說明，確認美國新增政治、選舉及社會議題廣告限制期已開始；在限制期前已取得至少一次曝光的廣告，可繼續投放。
items.summary_en: Meta’s October 27 official update confirms that its US restriction period for new political, electoral and social-issue ads has begun. Ads with at least one impression before the restriction period may continue running.
items.why: 相關限制會影響政治及議題倡議廣告的排期、審批與預算分配，並提醒代理商將平台政策納入投放風險管理。
items.why_en: The restriction affects campaign scheduling and compliance for election-related and issue advocacy advertisers, underscoring the need to build platform policy into media planning.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
highlights: 這是美國選舉前限制期的啟動更新，並非全新的一般商業廣告禁令。
既有廣告能否繼續投放，取決於限制期前是否已取得至少一次曝光。
highlights_en: This is an activation update for the US pre-election restriction, not a new blanket ban on commercial ads.
Continuing delivery depends on having recorded at least one impression before the restriction period.
items.detail:
Meta於10月27日更新官方選舉說明，確認美國新增政治、選舉及社會議題廣告限制期已開始；在限制期前已取得至少一次曝光的廣告，可繼續投放。

相關限制會影響政治及議題倡議廣告的排期、審批與預算分配，並提醒代理商將平台政策納入投放風險管理。

涉及美國政治或社會議題廣告的團隊，應核對Meta官方政策、帳戶資格、時區與既有廣告處理規則，再安排投放。

範圍限美國政治、選舉及社會議題廣告；具體帳戶操作須以Meta現行指引為準。
items.detail_en:
Meta’s October 27 official update confirms that its US restriction period for new political, electoral and social-issue ads has begun. Ads with at least one impression before the restriction period may continue running.

The restriction affects campaign scheduling and compliance for election-related and issue advocacy advertisers, underscoring the need to build platform policy into media planning.

Teams handling US political or social-issue ads should confirm the official policy, account eligibility, applicable time zone and treatment of existing ads before scheduling.

The scope is US political, electoral and social-issue ads; account-specific implementation should follow current Meta guidance.
items.next_step: 涉及美國政治或社會議題廣告的團隊，應核對Meta官方政策、帳戶資格、時區與既有廣告處理規則，再安排投放。
items.next_step_en: Teams handling US political or social-issue ads should confirm the official policy, account eligibility, applicable time zone and treatment of existing ads before scheduling.

items.title: McDonald’s向B&T確認FIFA世界盃贊助將隨現有協議結束
items.title_en: McDonald’s confirms to B&T that its FIFA World Cup sponsorship ends with its current agreement
items.summary: B&T於10月26日報道，McDonald’s全球行銷主管Morgan Flatley確認，全球FIFA世界盃贊助將隨現有協議完結；公司仍會參與體育及文化合作，並聚焦全年品牌體驗。
items.summary_en: B&T reported on October 26 that McDonald’s global marketing chief Morgan Flatley confirmed its global FIFA World Cup sponsorship would end with the current agreement. The company still plans sports and cultural partnerships, with a focus on year-round brand experiences.
items.why: 大型品牌重新評估長期體育贊助，反映全球曝光、粉絲互動與投資回報之間需要重新取捨。
items.why_en: The move invites a fresh look at the trade-off between global reach, fan engagement and measurable return from long-term sports sponsorships.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
highlights: B&T刊載Morgan Flatley向該媒體提供的聲明，而非只引用其他媒體推測。
公司表示仍會參與體育、足球及粉絲文化；未披露下一階段的具體預算分配。
highlights_en: B&T carries a statement supplied to it by Morgan Flatley, rather than relying solely on another outlet’s speculation.
The company says sport, football and fandom remain relevant; future budget allocations are not disclosed.
items.detail:
B&T於10月26日報道，McDonald’s全球行銷主管Morgan Flatley確認，全球FIFA世界盃贊助將隨現有協議完結；公司仍會參與體育及文化合作，並聚焦全年品牌體驗。

大型品牌重新評估長期體育贊助，反映全球曝光、粉絲互動與投資回報之間需要重新取捨。

檢視長期贊助的受眾觸達、品牌提升與銷售歸因，並比較其他體育及創作者合作形式。

報道包含公司向B&T提供的聲明，未披露完整合約或未來預算；不推斷財務影響。
items.detail_en:
B&T reported on October 26 that McDonald’s global marketing chief Morgan Flatley confirmed its global FIFA World Cup sponsorship would end with the current agreement. The company still plans sports and cultural partnerships, with a focus on year-round brand experiences.

The move invites a fresh look at the trade-off between global reach, fan engagement and measurable return from long-term sports sponsorships.

Review sponsorship reach, brand lift and attribution alongside alternative sports and creator partnerships.

The reporting includes a company statement to B&T, not the full contract or future budget; no financial impact is inferred.
items.next_step: 檢視長期贊助的受眾觸達、品牌提升與銷售歸因，並比較其他體育及創作者合作形式。
items.next_step_en: Review sponsorship reach, brand lift and attribution alongside alternative sports and creator partnerships.

items.title: Mastercard與MrBeast旗下Beast Industries公布創作者合作計劃
items.title_en: Mastercard and Beast Industries plan creator-commerce programmes
items.summary: Mastercard於10月26日宣布與Beast Industries合作，規劃面向創作者及新一代消費者的聯名卡、體驗、商業支援工具及教育計劃。
items.summary_en: Mastercard announced a partnership with Beast Industries on October 26, outlining planned co-branded cards, experiences, business support and education for creators and the next generation of consumers.
items.why: 品牌與創作者合作正探索由內容曝光延伸至支付、會員體驗及創作者營商支援。
items.why_en: Creator partnerships may connect content audiences with payments, loyalty experiences and business support.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
highlights: 合作範圍包括聯名卡、專屬權益及Priceless體驗，仍屬計劃安排。
雙方亦規劃創作者營商支援與理財教育；具體開放市場及推出日期尚未列明。
highlights_en: The planned collaboration covers co-branded cards, exclusive benefits and Priceless experiences.
Creator business support and financial education are also planned; the announcement does not specify launch dates or eligible markets.
items.detail:
Mastercard於10月26日宣布與Beast Industries合作，規劃面向創作者及新一代消費者的聯名卡、體驗、商業支援工具及教育計劃。

品牌與創作者合作正探索由內容曝光延伸至支付、會員體驗及創作者營商支援。

研究合作的實際權益設計與衡量指標，避免單憑創作者粉絲數推定轉化。

公告描述合作計劃，未列明具體推出日期、適用市場或已實現的商業成效。
items.detail_en:
Mastercard announced a partnership with Beast Industries on October 26, outlining planned co-branded cards, experiences, business support and education for creators and the next generation of consumers.

Creator partnerships may connect content audiences with payments, loyalty experiences and business support.

Evaluate actual benefits and measurement plans rather than assuming conversion from creator reach.

The announcement describes planned programmes without specified launch dates, markets or demonstrated commercial outcomes.
items.next_step: 研究合作的實際權益設計與衡量指標，避免單憑創作者粉絲數推定轉化。
items.next_step_en: Evaluate actual benefits and measurement plans rather than assuming conversion from creator reach.

items.title: OpenAI與Oracle擴大合作，計劃將Oracle企業應用與資料帶入ChatGPT
items.title_en: OpenAI and Oracle plan app and data integrations for ChatGPT
items.summary: OpenAI與Oracle於10月27日公布擴大企業合作，計劃透過正在開發的Oracle AI Workspace，讓員工在ChatGPT介面使用經授權的Oracle應用及企業資料。OpenAI產品亦可供合資格美國Oracle Marketplace客戶採購。
items.summary_en: On October 27, OpenAI and Oracle expanded their enterprise partnership. Oracle is developing AI Workspace to connect approved Oracle applications and data through a ChatGPT interface. Eligible US Oracle Marketplace customers can separately purchase certain OpenAI offerings.
items.why: 企業AI代理能否連接CRM、ERP及資料治理，是部署前的重要評估方向。
items.why_en: Integration with ERP, CRM and data governance matters more than the announcement alone for enterprise AI agents.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態

highlights_en: On October 27, OpenAI and Oracle expanded their enterprise partnership. Oracle is developing AI Workspace to connect approved Oracle applications and data through a ChatGPT interface. Eligible US Oracle Marketplace customers can separately purchase certain OpenAI offerings.
Oracle AI Workspace is under development; general global availability is not established.
items.detail:

企業AI代理能否連接CRM、ERP及資料治理，是部署前的重要評估方向。

Map permissions, approval owners and Oracle systems, then confirm product timing and regional access.

items.title: 新加坡SWITCH公布首批24間Champions of AI企業，另介紹小企AI工作坊進展
items.title_en: Singapore names 24 Champions of AI companies at SWITCH and reports small-business workshop progress
items.summary: 新加坡政府於10月27日SWITCH 2026開幕致辭中，宣布Champions of AI首批24間企業，並表示EnterpriseSG的代理式AI工作坊已協助近300間微企及小型企業製作原型。
items.summary_en: In its October 27 SWITCH 2026 opening speech, Singapore announced the first 24-company Champions of AI cohort and said EnterpriseSG agentic-AI workshops had helped close to 300 micro and small enterprises build prototypes.
items.why: 企業AI轉型正由工具試用延伸至流程重整、員工培訓與跨部門落地，對區域行銷及客戶服務團隊有參考價值。
items.why_en: Enterprise AI efforts increasingly involve process redesign, staff capability and cross-functional adoption, relevant to regional marketing and customer-service teams.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
highlights: 24間企業屬Champions of AI首批名單，重點包括企業流程與員工能力轉型。
近300間微企及小企屬另一工作坊進度數字，不能與首批企業名單混為一談。
highlights_en: The 24 companies form the first Champions of AI cohort, with enterprise transformation and workforce capability emphasized.
The close-to-300 figure concerns a separate workshop programme, not the Champions cohort.
items.detail:
新加坡政府於10月27日SWITCH 2026開幕致辭中，宣布Champions of AI首批24間企業，並表示EnterpriseSG的代理式AI工作坊已協助近300間微企及小型企業製作原型。

企業AI轉型正由工具試用延伸至流程重整、員工培訓與跨部門落地，對區域行銷及客戶服務團隊有參考價值。

關注新加坡官方後續的參與條件、工作坊資料及可量度案例。

首批24間企業與近300間工作坊參與企業屬不同群組；新加坡措施不能當作香港資助計劃。
items.detail_en:
In its October 27 SWITCH 2026 opening speech, Singapore announced the first 24-company Champions of AI cohort and said EnterpriseSG agentic-AI workshops had helped close to 300 micro and small enterprises build prototypes.

Enterprise AI efforts increasingly involve process redesign, staff capability and cross-functional adoption, relevant to regional marketing and customer-service teams.

Watch for official eligibility rules, workshop materials and measurable case studies.

The 24-company cohort and close-to-300 workshop participants are distinct groups; these Singapore initiatives are not Hong Kong grants.
items.next_step: 關注新加坡官方後續的參與條件、工作坊資料及可量度案例。
items.next_step_en: Watch for official eligibility rules, workshop materials and measurable case studies.

items.title: Google DeepMind公布Genie 4即時互動世界模型，僅向可信測試者初步推出
items.title_en: Google previews Genie 4 with native audio, limited to trusted testers
items.summary: Google DeepMind於10月27日公布Genie 4互動世界模型，加入原生音效及即時場景調整。目前僅以研究預覽形式提供予可信測試者。
items.summary_en: Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, adding native audio and real-time changes to interactive simulated worlds. It is currently a research preview for trusted testers.
items.why: 即時互動場景可能成為創意概念與分鏡探索的研究方向，尚非現成廣告製作流程。
items.why_en: Interactive worlds could inform creative ideation and storyboarding research, rather than an available advertising-production workflow.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
highlights: Google表示Genie 4可生成原生音效，並以自然語言即時調整場景。
目前只向有限可信測試者開放；Project Genie、Gemini API及AI Studio的擴大存取仍列為即將推出。
highlights_en: Google says Genie 4 adds native audio and natural-language steering of scenes in real time.
Access is limited to trusted testers; broader access through Project Genie, the Gemini API and AI Studio is described as coming soon.
items.detail:
Google DeepMind於10月27日公布Genie 4互動世界模型，加入原生音效及即時場景調整。目前僅以研究預覽形式提供予可信測試者。

即時互動場景可能成為創意概念與分鏡探索的研究方向，尚非現成廣告製作流程。

創意團隊可追蹤正式開放與授權條件，暫毋須為此調整生產流程。

擴大存取仍列為即將推出；不能當作已普遍開放或已獲廣告製作商用授權。
items.detail_en:
Google DeepMind announced Genie 4 on October 27, adding native audio and real-time changes to interactive simulated worlds. It is currently a research preview for trusted testers.

Interactive worlds could inform creative ideation and storyboarding research, rather than an available advertising-production workflow.

Creative teams can monitor access and licensing announcements; no immediate production change is warranted.

Broader access is described as coming soon; general availability and advertising-production licensing are not established.
items.next_step: 創意團隊可追蹤正式開放與授權條件，暫毋須為此調整生產流程。
items.next_step_en: Creative teams can monitor access and licensing announcements; no immediate production change is warranted.

items.title: Maybank新加坡以書法視覺創意宣傳反詐騙
items.title_en: Maybank Singapore turns scam phrases into calligraphy
items.summary: 新加坡Maybank的反詐騙展覽「The Most Expensive Words」於10月23日開幕，10月27日獲媒體報道。展覽將常見詐騙話術變成中英文書法作品，並標示相關詐騙類別的已報告損失。
items.summary_en: Maybank Singapore opened its 'The Most Expensive Words' anti-scam exhibition on October 23, with trade coverage on October 27. It presents familiar scam phrases as Chinese and English calligraphy alongside reported losses for the relevant scam categories.
items.why: 這是品牌以文化藝術重新包裝公共教育訊息的創意案例，值得觀察其如何令觀眾停下來閱讀。
items.why_en: The campaign is a creative example of using cultural art to make public-education messages worth stopping to read.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
highlights: 展覽於10月23日開幕，10月27日獲MARKETING-INTERACTIVE報道，作品涵蓋中英文書法。
作品價格標籤對應2025年相關詐騙類別的已報告損失，並非個別話術造成的損失。
highlights_en: The exhibition opened on October 23 and was reported on October 27, featuring Chinese and English calligraphy.
Price tags represent reported 2025 losses for the relevant scam categories, not losses caused by an individual phrase.
items.detail:
新加坡Maybank的反詐騙展覽「The Most Expensive Words」於10月23日開幕，10月27日獲媒體報道。展覽將常見詐騙話術變成中英文書法作品，並標示相關詐騙類別的已報告損失。

這是品牌以文化藝術重新包裝公共教育訊息的創意案例，值得觀察其如何令觀眾停下來閱讀。

檢視品牌教育內容是否有清楚行為指引，並把曝光與真正的認知或行為改變分開衡量。

展覽標示的是詐騙類別總損失，並非某句話造成的損失；活動成效未獲證實。
items.detail_en:
Maybank Singapore opened its 'The Most Expensive Words' anti-scam exhibition on October 23, with trade coverage on October 27. It presents familiar scam phrases as Chinese and English calligraphy alongside reported losses for the relevant scam categories.

The campaign is a creative example of using cultural art to make public-education messages worth stopping to read.

Review whether education campaigns provide clear behavioural guidance, and measure awareness separately from actual behaviour change.

Losses refer to scam categories, not individual phrases; campaign effectiveness is not established.
items.next_step: 檢視品牌教育內容是否有清楚行為指引，並把曝光與真正的認知或行為改變分開衡量。
items.next_step_en: Review whether education campaigns provide clear behavioural guidance, and measure awareness separately from actual behaviour change.
